Exact checker replay passed 145 assertions; no experimental data used to assert infinite proof.

value.rationale: This natural two-independent-project, shared-volunteer-cost model demonstrates the first possible group size for coexistence of two locally attracting mixed cooperation frequencies; its sharp impossibility half and exact cost interval provide nontrivial boundaries and reproducible benchmarks for nonlinear public-goods cooperation. The claim is scoped to a natural monotone benefit model, not broad field predictions.
